name: Espressif ESP32-DevKitC V4 with ESP-WROOM-32
record_note: This profile is specifically for ESP-WROOM-32 with 4 MiB module flash and a 40 MHz module crystal. DevKitC V4 supports multiple module variants and USB-UART bridge revisions; confirm the fitted parts. GPIO6–GPIO11 are dedicated to module SPI flash. Other pin, build, and flash details remain open.
